fieldNotes.truckGate: Barrier arm plus a sliding chain-link gate across the single truck drive where it crosses the fenced property line (Street View 2023-01/2024-07, pano 92NjOjdybFQsSc50yMJRpw).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth of any size beside the gate in any Street View heading; the only structure near the gate is a small landscaped sign island. Workers were standing on foot in the drive, not in a booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled gate (arm + slide gate) with no guard shack implies kiosk/call-box/remote check-in.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Two adjacent lanes at one gate point (sliding-gate lane + barrier-arm lane); both at the same property-line crossing.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Two lanes total at the single gate; assigned 1 inbound / 1 outbound, but lane assignment is inferred, not signed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed to the building W face (~12-15) and NE/E face (~15-20); 25-50 band by trailer count and bay rhythm. Exact count obscured by parked trailers.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large paved trailer-storage yard on the N/NW half of the parcel holds 40-50+ drop trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks wrap two building faces (W and NE/E) but read as one continuous combined dock operation rather than physically separate ship vs receive clusters; low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: CSX line runs ~150m S of the parcel along Faulkner area but no spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Atlanta metro (Lindridge/Martin Manor industrial pocket between Buckhead and Midtown), apartments and warehouses adjacent.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The large warehouse immediately SE across the internal drive is a separate parcel/tenant, excluded from the dairy perimeter.
fieldNotes.coords: Supplied coords (33.8186,-84.3324) landed ~2.7km NE in a residential area; corrected via Google geocode of 2121 Faulkner Rd NE to 33.813853,-84.358477 and confirmed by milk silos in satellite + Street View.
